jobs.title: .NET developer
jobs.description:
32 – 38 uur | € 3.500 – € 5.500 bruto per maand | Hybride werken mogelijk

Weet jij als .NET Developer de juiste code te schrijven voor slimme en innovatieve data-oplossingen? Met jouw werk help je ruim 10.000 autobedrijven vooruit. Bij ons krijg je niet alleen de kans om te programmeren, maar ook om actief mee te denken over nieuwe toepassingen en functionaliteiten. Klinkt werken met moderne Microsoft-technologieën jou als muziek in de oren? Dan is dit jouw volgende stap!

Jouw impact als .NET Developer

Als .NET Developer werk je in kleine, multidisciplinaire teams aan het ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van slimme softwareapplicaties. Je bent betrokken bij het hele ontwikkelproces – van idee tot implementatie. De applicaties die jij ontwikkelt, geven toonaangevende spelers in de automotivebranche waardevolle inzichten in hun data.

Jouw taken op een rij:

Klantwensen vertalen naar nieuwe features en verbeteringen.
(Door)ontwikkelen van applicaties op basis van microservices en cloudprincipes.
Bestaande applicaties migreren en nieuwe applicaties bouwen binnen een nieuw te ontwikkelen Azure-landingszone.
Samenwerken in een Agile/Scrumteam aan hoogwaardige softwareoplossingen.

Wat je krijgt

Een brutosalaris van € 3.500 – € 5.500 per maand (afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring).
Een werkweek van 32 tot 38 uur met hybride werkmogelijkheden.
Budget om je thuiswerkplek optimaal in te richten.
26 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.
Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per km.
Pensioenregeling via BeFrank, waarvan 50% van de premie door VWE wordt betaald.
Een moderne werkplek in Heerhugowaard, op 5 minuten lopen van het station.
Ruime studie- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden.
Een aantrekkelijke winstdelingsregeling.

Jouw team en werkomgeving

Je komt terecht in een hecht, betrokken team waarin samenwerking en kennisdeling centraal staan. De sfeer is informeel, open en collegiaal – van gezamenlijke lunches op ons dakterras tot gezellige borrels en onze jaarlijkse barbecue. Dankzij ons uitgebreide inwerkprogramma
voel je je al snel thuis.

Wat we van jou vragen

Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als .NET Developer of in een vergelijkbare functie.
Ervaring met C# en SQL.
Zowel Frontend- als Backend-ervaring.
Kennis van .NET, ASP.NET, CI/CD (Azure DevOps) en Agile/Scrum-werkwijzen.
Ervaring met geautomatiseerd testen.
Kennis van Angular en/of Blazor is een pré.
Je hebt oog voor schone, onderhoudbare code en deelt graag je kennis met collega’s.

Over VWE Automotive

Werken bij VWE Automotive betekent onderdeel zijn van de marktleider in de Benelux op het gebied van data en IT voor de automotivebranche. Via onze merken VWE, Finnik en Automotive Trade Center bieden we klanten toegang tot slimme dataoplossingen, rapportages en internationale markten. Ons geavanceerde dataplatform – gevoed door API’s en EDI – groeit continu en maakt gebruik van de nieuwste technologieën.

Help jij mee om onze software nóg slimmer te maken?

Solliciteer vandaag nog en bouw mee aan de toekomst van automotive data bij VWE!

Onze dynamische wereld verandert continu, en jij verandert met ons mee.

Als AI Developer werk je aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van AI-oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem.

Je ontwikkelt AI-agents en slimme applicaties met Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel en het Microsoft Agent Framework. Daarbij combineer je sterke .NET- en Azure-kennis met AI-concepten zoals agents, orchestration, tracing en API-integraties.

Het bouwen van AI-agents in C# (.NET)

Ontwikkelen van AI-enabled applicaties (pro-code, geen low-code)
API-integraties en backend services
Samenwerken met frontend- en data engineers om end-to-end AI-oplossingen te realiseren
Experimenteren met tooling zoals CrewAI, n8n of AI-georiënteerde editors

jobs.description:
About Mendix

Mendix, a Siemens business, is the global leader in low-code application development. Our platform empowers organizations to rapidly build, integrate, and deploy enterprise-grade applications using visual modeling, abstracting away sophisticated coding. We enable seamless collaboration between business users and developers, accelerating digital transformation for our customers worldwide. Discover how global organizations are innovating with Mendix by exploring our Customer Stories.

About The Role

Are you a passionate and innovative software developer eager to shape the future of application development? Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented Junior Software Developer to join our Mendix team. In an era where AI-assisted platforms are revolutionizing how applications are built, Mendix stands at the forefront, empowering both technical and non-technical users to create powerful solutions with unprecedented speed and collaboration.

Unlike traditional programming approaches that can obscure business logic, Mendix offers a clear, visual development environment. This enables diverse stakeholders, from business analysts to software engineers, to actively participate in the development process, fostering understanding and delivering superior applications faster. Your contributions will directly enhance the productivity and innovation capabilities of development communities worldwide.

What You'll Do

Take part in the development of the Mendix platform, a leading low-code application development solution.
Engage in short feedback cycles to break down complex challenges and construct effective solutions.
Take ownership of your work and contribute to team success.
Thrive in a collaborative environment, actively participating in discussions and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptualization and design to testing, deployment, and maintenance.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a motivated individual with:

A Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Demonstrated proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as C# or TypeScript.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and a keen interest in employing them to improve efficiency.
A strong passion for technology, coupled with excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
The ability to learn quickly, adapt to new technologies, and adopt continuous improvement.
Strong communication and social skills, with a desire to work optimally within a team.

What We Offer

At Siemens Digital Industries Software, we are committed to fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment. We offer:

A competitive salary with regular performance evaluations and clear opportunities for career advancement.
Generous paid time off (30 days PTO) to support a healthy work-life balance.
A flexible hybrid work model that combines the benefits of office collaboration with remote flexibility.
Dedicated "crafting days" (2 per month) to focus on personal development, innovation, or learning new skills.
Comprehensive career development training and continuous learning opportunities.
A dedicated training budget for professional development to help you grow your expertise.
Engaging team events and outings, fostering a strong sense of community.
Excellent daily lunch options at the office (where applicable).
Flexible working hours to accommodate individual needs and promote well-being.
Support for various modes of travel to and from the office (where applicable).

Why Us?

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

The salary range for this position is €55-65,000 annually, and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Talent Tooling
jobs.description:
At Optiver, we’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Global Talent Assessment Tooling Team (GTAT), the cornerstone of our global recruitment, engaging 100,000+ users annually. You'll be instrumental in ensuring scalability and reliability of our in house built platforms. With expertise in server-side platforms and a genuine interest in UI/UX, you'll contribute to the full software development lifecycle of our global platforms, serving as the central hub for all talent assessments, training and education activities, and test authorization. Join us in shaping the future of global talent acquisition at Optiver.

Who We Are

Optiver’s story began over 30 years ago, when we started business as a single trader on the floor of Amsterdam’s options exchange. Today, we are at the forefront of trading and technology as a leading global electronic market maker, focused on pricing, execution and risk management.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining our talent assessment tooling platform and our assessments. This critical infrastructure is key to our ability to hire at scale and speed, representing one of the first interactions individuals have with Optiver during their recruitment journey. You’ll work within a dynamic team to ensure the platform's scalability and reliability, contributing to the success of our global talent assessment initiatives. You’ll work closely with our recruitment teams globally on a day to day basis to ensure that the platform is scalable, reliable, and user-friendly.

Some of what you’ll do day to day:

Design, develop and maintain our assessment tooling platform and features supporting recruitment
Collaborate with recruitment teams on a global scale to ensure that the platform is scalable, reliable, and user-friendly
Write clean, maintainable code that is easy to understand and modify and participate in code reviews to ensure that code meets quality standards
Utilize frontend technologies (React/Angular) to enhance user interfaces and experiences.

Who You Are

Strong technical background consisting of 3+ years of experience in full stack development
Proficiency in server-side development utilizing C# .NET or Python
Experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL or SQL Server)
Experience with frontend technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks
A proactive approach to problem solving and an entrepreneurial attitude
Ability to clearly explain your thoughts through written and verbal communication, ask the right questions, and work collaboratively with a range of technical and non technical stakeholders

Nice to Haves

Experience in UI/UX design
Experience with server hosting on cloud providers (e.g. AWS)

What You'll Get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool.
The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 different countries.
25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards.
Training opportunities, discounts on health insurance, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses.
Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, in-house physio and chair massages, organised sports and leisure activities, and Friday afternoon drinks.
Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events.
Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats.

WHO WE ARE:

At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe.

recruitment inquiry form

.

We cannot accept applications via email for data protection reasons.
We do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role.

DIVERSITY STATEMENT:

Optiver is committed to

diversity and inclusion

.

De Impact die je gaat maken als .Net Architect

Met de FORCE Product Suite (FPS)
en het Quion Service Platform (QSP)
bieden wij een end-to-end platform voor hypotheekverwerking. Deze oplossingen ondersteunen enkele van de grootste financiële instellingen van Nederland bij een van hun meest cruciale processen.
Deze functie biedt je de kans om architectuurkeuzes te maken die impact hebben op miljoenen hypotheekprocessen in Nederland. Je werkt samen met vooraanstaande financiële instellingen, ervaren architecten en gedreven ontwikkelteams aan platformen die essentieel zijn voor de Nederlandse hypotheekmarkt. Het platform is continue in ontwikkeling, zowel over de as van nieuwe proposities als de technische doorontwikkeling.
Bij Topicus krijg je de ruimte om richting te geven, te vernieuwen en daadwerkelijk het verschil te maken.

Wat je gaat doen als Architect .NET

Als Architect maak je deel uit van het Solution Architecture Team (SAT) en/of het Core Team. Je werkt nauw samen met productteams, stakeholders en klanten aan de strategische ontwikkeling van onze platformen. Je vertaalt businessdoelstellingen naar duurzame architectuuroplossingen en bewaakt de samenhang binnen een complex applicatielandschap. Daarbij heb je oog voor zowel business capabilities als technische architectuurprincipes, waarbij aspecten zoals security, performance, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid vanzelfsprekend onderdeel zijn van je afwegingen.

Je bent niet alleen richtinggevend op architectuurniveau, maar ook een verbindende factor tussen business, development teams en klanten.

Bij Topicus geloven we dat mensen het beste presteren wanneer ze kunnen doen waar ze goed in zijn. Daarom zoeken we een architect die visie combineert met pragmatisme, anderen inspireert en techniek weet te verbinden met bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

jobs.title: Jr. Application Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Ben jij klaar om impact te maken in een snel veranderende wereld? Wil jij bijdragen aan de volgende generatie logistieke oplossingen? Solliciteer dan nu!

Een startpremie van € 1.000 bruto wanneer je vóór 1 december 2026 jouw arbeidsovereenkomst ondertekent;

Innovatie wordt steeds belangrijker in een wereld die continu verandert. Bij Ewals Cargo Care
streven we ernaar om het verschil te maken in de dynamische logistieke markt. Onze ambitie is om voorop te blijven lopen door middel van onderscheidende en innovatieve oplossingen. We zoeken voortdurend naar slimme manieren om uitdagingen aan te pakken, processen te verbeteren en nieuwe kansen te benutten.

Als Junior Application Development Engineer
werk je mee aan de interne ontwikkeling van applicaties die de kernprocessen van Ewals Cargo Care ondersteunen en verbeteren.

De startdatum voor deze rol is voor 1 December 2026 of na 18 januari 2027!

Hoe maak jij impact?

Wij zoeken een Junior Application Development Engineer die eigenaarschap neemt over zijn of haar werk en trots is op wat wordt opgeleverd. We waarderen professionals die begrijpen welke oplossingen zij ontwikkelen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de kwaliteit ervan en open communiceren over zowel hun expertise als hun ontwikkelpunten.

In deze rol werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve digitale oplossingen die processen binnen de gehele organisatie ondersteunen en verbeteren. Samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines analyseer je kansen, ontwerp en ontwikkel je Minimum Viable Products (MVP's) en help je deze succesvol naar productie te brengen.

Zo werken we komend jaar onder andere aan een portal voor klanten en leveranciers, een applicatie voor onze procurement organisatie en de verdere doorontwikkeling van onze oplossing voor de commerciële organisatie op het gebied van contractmanagement, tendermanagement, budgettering en forecasting. Daarnaast speelt het team een belangrijke rol in het verder ontwikkelen en productierijp maken van proof-of-concepts die door het Innovation Team zijn ontwikkeld.

Je krijgt de kans om organisatiebreed samen te werken en ervaring op te doen in alle fasen van de softwareontwikkelcyclus: van het analyseren van businessvraagstukken en het ontwerpen van oplossingen tot het ontwikkelen, testen, implementeren en beheren van applicaties in productie.

Wat ga je doen?

Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe applicaties en processen, of bestaande oplossingen continu verbeteren.
Intensief samenwerken met stakeholders die functionele requirements vaststellen.
Samen met het developmentteam het volledige ontwikkeltraject beheren.
Demonstraties verzorgen van opgeleverde oplossingen om de effectiviteit ervan te evalueren met stakeholders.
Werken binnen een Scrum-team.
Full-stack softwareontwikkeling uitvoeren.

Wie zoeken we?

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Software Engineering, Informatica, IT, Technology of een vergelijkbare richting.
0 tot 3 jaar werkervaring.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal, Nederlands is een pre.
Affiniteit met de Scrum-methodiek.
Ervaring met of sterke interesse in programmeertalen zoals C#
, TypeScript
en SQL
.
Bij voorkeur ervaring met React
voor het ontwikkelen van gebruikersinterfaces.
Bij voorkeur ervaring met microservice-architecturen
en Kubernetes
.
Bij voorkeur ervaring met Microsoft Azure
-diensten, zoals Web Apps, Managed Storage en Azure SQL Databases.
Interesse in en begrip van de ontwikkelingen, toepassingen en impact van Artificial Intelligence (AI)
.
Een hands-on mentaliteit die past bij onze bedrijfscultuur.
Creatief denkvermogen en het vermogen om technische uitdagingen vanuit verschillende perspectieven te benaderen.
Sterke samenwerkingsvaardigheden in een dynamische en snel veranderende omgeving.
Een echte passie voor applicatieontwikkeling
en de ambitie om impact te maken.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Ewals Cargo Care krijg je de kans om je carrière te starten binnen een innovatieve internationale logistieke organisatie. Je werkt met moderne technologieën, draagt bij aan de digitalisering van onze processen en krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf zowel technisch als persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen we aan slimme oplossingen die de toekomst van logistiek vormgeven.
Een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur.
Hybride werken, na je onboarding kun je 2-3 dagen thuis werken! We faciliteren je thuiswerkplek.
Marktconform salaris met 8% vakantiegeld en 1000 euro startpremie!
Een tijdelijk contract dat bij goed functioneren wordt omgezet naar vast.
Pensioenregeling met slechts 5% eigen bijdrage.
28 vakantiedagen + mogelijkheid om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen.
Reiskostenvergoeding, gezondheidschecks, fietsplan en meer.
Toegang tot opleidingen via de Ewals Academy en doorgroeimogelijkheden

Over Ewals Cargo Care

We geloven in een betere en betekenisvolle supply chain voor iedereen. Dat realiseren we door samen met onze partners en leveranciers slimme en duurzame communities te bouwen. We bieden betrouwbare oplossingen om de cargo van onze klanten te vervoeren. We care, connect, move.
Bij Ewals Cargo Care, met 2.550 medewerkers in 13 landen, zijn we meer dan een logistiek bedrijf, we zijn een familie die naar elkaar omkijkt. Met meer dan een eeuw aan ervaring zijn we uitgegroeid tot een grote internationale speler, maar onze roots als familiebedrijf vormen nog steeds de basis van alles wat we doen. Wat ons écht definieert, is niet de naam op het gebouw, maar de manier waarop we elkaar elke dag steunen, zien en bijstaan. We geloven in mensen, en we investeren in hun groei met oprechte aandacht en zorg. Zelfs wanneer het tempo hoog ligt, verliezen we nooit uit het oog waar we kunnen helpen of aanmoedigen.
We werken vanuit vertrouwen, gaan uit van goede intenties en zoeken steeds de balans tussen ambitie en realisme. Onze cultuur is informeel, open en energiek , waar communicatie gemakkelijk verloopt en iedereen benaderbaar is, ongeacht rol of functie. We zijn er trots op dat we anders zijn dan andere logistieke bedrijven, en precies die trots drijft ons om te blijven groeien en vernieuwen. Via programma’s zoals ons Young Professional Program en de Ewals Academy helpen we onze mensen hun toekomst vorm te geven.

We care, we connect, we move — samen. Dat is de geest die ons al generaties lang draagt en die ons blijft leiden terwijl we de toekomst met optimisme en veerkracht omarmen.

Please note:
We are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship
.
We are not a recognized sponsor with the IND (Dutch Immigration and Naturalisation Service)
.
This means we cannot hire candidates who require sponsorship
, including those on a Highly Skilled Migrant (HSM) visa
or those seeking employment under a "zoekjaar" (orientation year) visa
.
Acquisition is not allowed. If you send any CV we might consider them as direct applicants and continue the process without agency involvement.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin
jobs.description:
Company Description

At KEENFINITY Group
, we are a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions. With over 4,000 employees in over 50 countries worldwide, our ambition is clear: we offer more than just technology – we secure, connect, and amplify the moments that matter in life.

Our Audio business is part of the Keenfinity Group and operates as an independent company – giving our iconic brands the independence and agility to thrive in today’s market. As part of a global family that includes Bosch, RTS, Electro-Voice, Dynacord, and Telex
, we deliver world-class professional audio, building safety, intercom, and communication solutions that connect concerts, broadcasts, houses of worship, stadiums, and schools. We develop and manufacture these systems in our own plants across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Our vision is to be the industry’s most admired company, driven by customer success. We strive to live and work according to our core values of Customer Success, Passion, Boldness, and Integrity.

Customer Success: Unmatched customer experience, end to end.

Passion: We love what we do, it drives everything we deliver.

Boldness: We challenge the status quo. We innovate. We lead.

Integrity: We do the right thing. Always.

What’s in it for you?

Working with us means experiencing the best of both worlds: the global impact and prestige of industry-leading brands, combined with the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a newly independent company. In this dynamic environment, your ideas will not get lost in bureaucracy. We empower you to take true ownership, accelerate your growth, and collaborate with passionate experts worldwide to build solutions you can genuinely be proud of.

Job Description

As a Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin
, you will help us rebuild and significantly expand the software simulator for our DICENTIS conference devices
. The simulator acts like real hardware on the network, allowing our development and test teams to validate server behavior, run automated regression tests, and develop software without always needing access to physical devices.

We already have an existing simulator, but it currently covers only a limited set of device behaviors and runs on an aging technology stack. Your project will be to rebuild it using a newer technology foundation that we are already investing in, while expanding its coverage from approximately 30% to 80–90% of real device behavior
.

You will work on a long-term project with a tangible impact on how our engineering teams develop, test, and maintain our products. The final solution will run on both Windows and Linux
and become an important part of our automated testing and development environment.

During Your Internship, You Will

Get familiar with the existing device simulator, DICENTIS devices, and the newer technology stack used for the rebuild.
Analyze the behavior and capabilities of real devices and identify which scenarios are already simulated and which are still missing.
Define and prioritize the device behaviors required to significantly expand simulator coverage.
Design and implement new simulated device scenarios using C# and/or C++.
Develop software that communicates over the network and behaves like the corresponding physical devices.
Make the simulator compatible with both Windows and Linux.
Develop and maintain automated tests that use the simulator as a replacement for physical hardware.
Integrate the simulator into our automated build and test pipeline, including continuous integration where applicable.
Document supported device behaviors, architecture, usage, and known limitations.
Work closely with engineers and testers to understand their needs and ensure the simulator is practical for everyday development and testing.
Break down a long-term project into manageable milestones and provide regular progress updates to your supervising team.

Qualifications

You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field.
Solid programming skills in C# and/or C++.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, client-server communication, and networked devices.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and break down a larger project into manageable steps.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
Motivation to learn, investigate technical problems, and develop a solution from an existing foundation.

It Is a Plus If You Have

Experience with .NET or .NET Core.
Familiarity with network protocols or device communication standards.
Experience with automated testing or continuous integration tools such as Jenkins.
Experience working in a Linux-based development environment.
Coursework or project experience in software engineering, networking, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
An interest in audio, conferencing technology, embedded systems, or connected devices.

Additional Information

💼 What We Offer:

A hands-on internship in an international team.
Close guidance from experienced professionals.
A dynamic role where your input and ideas are appreciated.
The option to work from home one day per week.
An internship allowance between €500 and €600 per month (based on full-time employment).

📝 Application Process

Interested? Hit the apply button!
Phone meeting with a Keenfinity Group campus recruiter;
Interview with team members;
Contract offers from Keenfinity Group.

🌱 Join us at KEENFINITY!

At Keenfinity Group we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology.

We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self.

Keenfinity is an equal opportunity employer, offering equal opportunities for all. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and can offer support, if needed. When everyone has a chance to contribute, we all do better.

Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

The role

We are looking for a Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer to join our Data Science & AI team as a consultant. This is a client-facing role first: most of your time is spent on client engagements, designing and building Azure infrastructure and platform solutions, advising on cloud strategy, and representing Sia's technical delivery capability directly to the client. Alongside that, you will get hands-on with AI on the side of the business: building demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry that support new client opportunities, rather than running or maintaining an internal platform. Work directly with client teams and stakeholders as a consultant, explaining technical trade-offs and architecture decisions in plain language.
Design and implement Azure infrastructure, including networking, compute, storage, and identity components (Azure AD/Entra ID, VNets, App Services, AKS).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).

Build demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry to support business development and potential client work.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues across hybrid and cloud-native environments.
Advise clients on cloud migration strategy, landing zone design, and the Azure Well-Architected Framework.
Collaborate with client IT teams, architects, and Sia consultants to deliver technical roadmaps and implementation plans.

What you bring

Comfortable working directly with clients as a consultant, and able to explain technical trade-offs in plain language.

jobs.description:
Head of Engineering bij Budget Thuis

Kandidaatprofiel

Over 7 years of experience in engineering leadership, building and scaling high-performing teams
Able to translate company vision and OKRs into technical direction and consistent delivery
Hands-on expertise in CI/CD, DORA metrics, cloud, and security-by-design
Experience working within a product operating model, linking engineering to customer and business value
Skilled in driving transformation, reducing technical debt, and modernizing platforms and processes
Strong communicator, fostering alignment and trust with Product, Business, and C-level stakeholders
Track record of managing and coaching managers

Budget Thuis makes essential household services simple and affordable, and that formula has fueled years of fast growth. Technology plays an ever bigger part in that story, from a new product operating model to major investments in AI. In close partnership with the CTO, the Head of Engineering sets the technical strategy that drives the next phase.

Over Budget Thuis

Gas, electricity, internet, and TV need to be available, reliable, and affordable, without complications. Budget Thuis is the only provider in the Netherlands that brings all these telecom and energy services under one roof. Its no-nonsense approach resonates: households switch to Budget Thuis for the convenience of one provider and the savings that come with it. Based in central Amsterdam, nearly 450 team members operate in an informal yet driven environment, blending a hands-on mindset with a strong focus on results. Together, they deliver exceptional service while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Commercially and operationally, Budget Thuis has built a strong position. Its TV proposition has launched, and by the end of this year its own fiber network will reach 2.4 million households. Rapid expansion and a series of acquisitions have also added complexity to the organization and its systems, opening up room to simplify and scale.

To support further expansion, the company has moved from a project-driven organization to a product operating model. Multidisciplinary teams take end-to-end ownership of processes and the customer experience, coordinated through OKRs, with product, engineering, and the business as equal voices at the table. The new structure is in place and has strong backing from the executive board and the CTO. Now the focus shifts to embedding the new way of working throughout engineering.

“We've laid the foundation for a product engineering culture, now we need a leader who can turn that into consistent execution, at scale, across every team.” - Noureddine Abdelaziz CTO

Vacature Head of Engineering

With ambitious growth goals ahead, the Head of Engineering shapes the technology roadmap and develops a high-performing engineering function that aligns closely with product goals and architectural priorities. The target way of working is clear: trunk-based development with short-lived branches, and automated testing instead of manual QA, with CI/CD and DORA metrics as the backbone. The stack runs on .NET, in a hybrid setup of on-premises infrastructure and Azure.

Leading six Engineering Managers and 92 engineers across seven domains, including a recently added data platform team, the Head of Engineering sets the bar for delivery and technical quality. The markets behind these domains differ widely: internet and TV call for a different approach than mobile or energy. Building a strong management layer to delegate to with confidence is an important part of the job. So is shaping how teams develop and the frameworks they work within, with collaboration and ownership as the norm. Reporting directly to the CTO and part of the CTO’s management team, the Head of Engineering works closely with the Head of Product, forming a leadership duo that connects product and engineering. Collaboration with peers in design, architecture, business, and operations further strengthens this integrated approach.

The timing makes this an attractive moment to join. The heavy lifting of the restructuring is done. What lies ahead is the part where engineering leadership makes the difference. That means completing the transformation, so Budget Thuis can respond faster to what customers need. It also means putting the modernization strategy for the legacy applications into practice. The rollout of AI within engineering is in this leader's hands, with plenty of room to operate. The foundation is already there: a company-wide Centre of Excellence led by the CTO and an in-house GPU server running open-source models. The key choices on automation and AI agents are being made now.

Success in this role rests on technical depth and a genuine enjoyment of people management. That combination ideally grows from a career that started in software engineering and moved step by step into leadership. It gives the credibility to challenge and coach engineers, while the Engineering Managers run day-to-day execution. Experience leading a transformation in a larger organization is essential, as systems thinking here applies to culture and behavior as much as to technology. Microservices, cloud-native technologies, and developer experience are familiar territory. A leader eager to make a lasting impact will find a natural fit here.

jobs.title: Senior Dynamics F&O Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

This is Allego

Allego is the leading company for fast and ultra-fast charging solutions to companies and consumers throughout Europe. We build and operate our public charging network ranging from regular charging to state-of-the-art high-power charging that can be used by all electric cars, providing a seamless charging experience. Our goal is to contribute to zero-emission mobility and allow EV drivers to charge at the right place with the right speed.

The EV market is emerging and changing rapidly. With our proven track record and long experience, we keep driving forward with confidence.

About The Role

As a Senior Dynamics 365 Engineer, you will play a key role in strengthening our Dynamics landscape across F&O, CE, and the Power Platform. You’ll work within a skilled internal engineering team supporting the technology behind Allego’s European charging infrastructure operations.

In this role, you will design, build, and improve solutions across our full Dynamics stack - from X++ development in F&O to Power Apps and integrations using Azure services. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, and internal business stakeholders to build reliable, scalable, and future-ready systems.

We are looking for someone who enjoys working across multiple Dynamics areas, is comfortable in a modern engineering environment, and is eager to help us further adopt the Power Platform and Azure technologies.

What You Will Do

Develop, extend, and optimise functionality in Dynamics 365 F&O and Dynamics 365 CE
Build solutions using Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Design and implement integrations using Azure Logic Apps, REST APIs, OData, DMF, and Azure API Management
Participate in solution design, code reviews, and technical architecture discussions
Work with Azure DevOps to manage work items, repositories, branching, and CI/CD pipelines
Ensure best practices in the D365 extension model, code quality, performance, and maintainability
Support continuous improvement of our development approach (e.g., automated testing, RSAT/ATL, LCS environment management)
Work closely with functional consultants and internal customers to analyse requirements and translate them into clean, scalable solutions
Break down work into deliverables and provide accurate time estimates

Job Requirements

What You Bring

5+ years professional development experience with Dynamics 365 F&O / X++.
Strong experience with Power Platform (PowerApps, Power Automate, Dataverse).
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD.
Solid understanding of integrations, including REST APIs, OData, DMF, and Logic Apps.
Nice to have experience with Dynamics 365 CE / CRM development.
Comfortable working in an Agile environment and collaborating in hybrid teams.
Ability to communicate clearly with internal customers and colleagues.
You are fluent in English.
You are able to visit our office in Arnhem.

Our Offer

This role allows you to work within a team of specialists contributing directly to the technology powering European EV charging. You will be at the forefront of modern charging and mobility solutions.

We offer a competitive salary package with strong secondary conditions, including:

End-of-year premium
Personal budget
A solid pension scheme
Opportunities for professional training and certifications
Hybrid working: a healthy balance between our Arnhem office and working from home

You’ll join colleagues who are motivated to make a real impact and who believe that working together is the key to driving zero-emission mobility forward. Expect a challenging role in a fast-paced, ambitious environment where you can grow, innovate, and help shape our Dynamics landscape.

jobs.description:
Azure Cloud Architect bij Sogeti

Wij zijn op zoek naar twee ervaren Azure Cloud Architecten. Dit doen wij vanuit ons Cloud Competence Center van waaruit wij onze cloudklanten ondersteunen.

Jouw rol als Azure Cloud Architect

Als Azure Cloud Architect bij Sogeti ontwerp je schaalbare en veilige Microsoft Azure-architecturen. Je richt Landing Zones in, inclusief security. Daarnaast adviseer je organisaties over cloudmigraties en applicatiemodernisering.

Je werkt nauw samen met DevOps-teams om automation en CI/CD-pipelines te implementeren. Ook integreer je containerplatforms zoals AKS en serverless services. Verder zorg je voor monitoring en observability.

In jouw rol begeleid je architectuursessies en stakeholderworkshops, waarbij je concepten helder weet over te brengen en organisaties helpt hun cloudstrategie te realiseren.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een ervaren Azure Cloud Architect met een passie voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve cloudoplossingen.
Je beschikt over HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als Cloud Architect, met een focus op Microsoft Azure.
Identity & Access Management, Infrastructure as Code (zoals ARM, Bicep of Terraform) en CI/CD-pipelines zijn voor jou bekende begrippen.
Je hebt ervaring met container orchestration en weet hoe je serverless oplossingen en API Management toepast.
Je bent bekend met architectuurframeworks zoals CAF, TOGAF en ArchiMate.
Certificeringen zoals AZ-305, AZ-104 en/of AZ-500 zijn een sterke bevestiging van jouw expertise.

Een of twee keer per jaar neem je je werk mee naar het veld om de connectiviteit live te valideren samen met coalitiepartners in live scenario's onder realistische omstandigheden. Defensie zet zich in voor de belangen, welvaart en vrijheid van Nederland. We zijn dagelijks actief in binnen- en buitenland. Onze wereldwijde inzet versterkt de internationale samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat mensen zich in vrijheid kunnen ontplooien. Nu en in de toekomst.

Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Wat we samen gaan bereiken:

Dit ga je doen:

Als Senior Test Automation Engineer bij Astek Nederland kom je niet om simpelweg scripts te runnen. Onze klanten (van de energiesector tot de semi-overheid) zitten vaak midden in uitdagende transities: van legacy naar cloud-native, of van handmatig testen naar full-blown CI/CD pipelines. Jij bent de specialist die de klant helpt navigeren. Of de stack nu vraagt om Cypress, Playwright, Tosca of Robot Framework: jij doorgrondt de architectuur en adviseert over de beste aanpak. Jij bent degene die developers meeneemt in het verhaal dat kwaliteit een gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid is. Kortom: jij brengt de senioriteit die nodig is om testautomatisering strategisch te laten landen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

Strategisch Advies: Je kijkt verder dan de bug. Je analyseert de behoeften van de klant en adviseert over de teststrategie en tooling die optimaal aansluit bij hun specifieke architectuur.
Engineeren: Je bouwt en optimaliseert robuuste, schaalbare frameworks die standhouden in een continu veranderende omgeving.
CI/CD Integratie: Je zorgt dat geautomatiseerde tests een integraal en betrouwbaar onderdeel worden van de deployment pipeline (bijv. Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
Lead & Coaching: In consultancy-omgevingen ben jij de deskundige. Je coacht collega's en neemt een natuurlijke voortrekkersrol binnen Agile-teams om de kwaliteitsstandaard te verhogen.

Wat jou onderscheidt:

Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in testautomatisering en bent gewend om te acteren binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen.
Tooling is voor jou een middel, geen doel. Je hebt diepgaande kennis van (meerdere) frameworks zoals Cypress, Playwright, Tosca, Selenium of Robot Framework.
Je hebt ruime ervaring met API-testen en begrijpt hoe microservices en moderne architecturen in elkaar steken.
Je bent communicatief sterk: je kunt technische keuzes onderbouwen richting zowel developers als management.
Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Waarom Astek voor jou de juiste stap is:

Bij ons heb je de regie over je eigen loopbaan, zowel in je projecten als in je beloning. Kies je beloningsmodel: Ga je voor het Profit-model (een unieke combinatie van zekerheid en een zeer hoog variabel inkomen voor de ondernemende professional) of liever voor het Solid-model (een stabiel, hoog marktconform salaris met uitgebreide extra's)?
Onbeperkt Groeien: Wij geloven niet in vaste budgetten. Heb jij een specifieke certificering of training nodig om de beste te blijven in je vak? Wij regelen het. Zonder limiet.
Brabantse Gezelligheid: We zijn een hecht team met korte lijnen. Naast de inhoud maken we tijd voor fun: van jaarlijkse citytrips (Marbella!) tot regiouitjes en familiedagen.

Dit bieden wij

Een vast contract vanaf dag één
Een competitief salarispakket afgestemd op jouw ervaring -> wil je alvast een beeld hebben? Neem dan een kijkje naar onze salarismeter
28 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen
Hybride werken, je werkt 1 tot 2 dagen op kantoor bij de klant
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling
Flexibele mobiliteitsvergoeding voor auto, OV of fiets – of leaseauto
Een cafetariaregeling voor aankopen die jou in je werk ondersteunen, denk aan een telefoon, laptop etc. (50% belastingvoordeel)
Onbeperkt opleidingsbudget (We vergoeden alle opleidingen en trainingen die bijdragen aan jouw professionele ontwikkeling)
Samenwerking met OpenUp: toegang tot gecertificeerde psychologen, workshops en ondersteuning voor jou en je familie
Ieder kwartaal uitjes met collega's en een jaarlijkse internationale trip (Zo zijn we o.a. al geweest in Dublin, Mallorca, Ibiza, Valencia, Barcelona, Lissabon en dit jaar gaan we naar Marbella!)

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.

Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.RoleBased in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.QualificationsFor this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
Several years of professional software development experience.

Large software projects and mature codebases.

Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

During the spring of 2020 Hailey HR was founded. We're a Swedish SaaS HR-tech company that want to digitalise, simplify and modernise the HR industry with our HR-system - join us on our journey!

About the position
💼
Our Integrations department builds and develops the integrations that connect Hailey with the systems our customers already use. That includes the standard integrations many customers rely on and custom builds for individual customers, which we publish in our integrations store. The store is where you can find both our own in-house built integrations and ones our partners build against our API.

You'll join a team with three backend developers and two Project Leaders and one HEad of Integrations. The Project Leaders keep in touch with the third parties we integrate with and own the quality assurance of what we build. As a developer, you'll build and maintain both standard integrations and custom builds for customers, from first commit until they run reliably in production. You'll also improve the integrations we already have and fix the problems that might arise after deployment as well as regular maintenance. You'll take part in refining backend requirements and dig into the customer problem behind each potential solution. When partners building their own integrations against our API run into technical questions, you'll help them too. Along the way, you'll help shape our integration patterns and how we work as a team, in close collaboration with Product, Customer Success and our other development teams.

Our integration services are built in .NET with modern frameworks and design patterns. We focus on quality, maintainability and scalability. We value automation and use CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, code analysis and deployment, so it's a plus if you see the value in that too.

There are plenty of chances to learn and grow here, and you'll soon own a lot of your daily work. It's perfectly fine if you don't know all our frameworks and patterns yet. We care more about your mindset and your willingness to learn.

What are we looking for?

Education & experience: A Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or an equivalent field with at least one year of relevant experience.
Minimum 1 years of backend development experience.
Interest in working with integrations.
Full professional fluency in Swedish and strong English skills, both spoken and written.

We believe you are:

Flexible and thrives in an innovative and dynamic environment, where solutions are always open to discussion.
Enjoy working in a team, pair programming, and see the value of code reviews because you work closely with your colleagues in the team.
Loving table tennis! (or at least find it okay, it’s a part of our culture after all 🏓)

.Net , REST, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, salary processes and HR processes in general, User provisioning, and to some extent Event sourcing, CQRS, AMQP, Layered architecture, AAA-patterns for unit testing, Scripted CI/CD-pipelines, Efficient use of AI

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Behind that journey sits a powerful digital platform enabling everything from checkout and payments to order management, delivery, retail tools, and customer self‑service.

You will join a focused team working across a critical part of the customer journey, building and validating solutions that customers globally and hundreds of internal users depend on every day. With real ownership, close collaboration, and global impact, this role plays a key part in ensuring reliability, performance, and quality across Polestar’s digital ecosystem.

We are now looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join Polestar Digital at our headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of customer‑facing digital products and internal platforms that support the vehicle purchasing journey.

You will work across frontend, backend, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, validating solutions and ensuring that features meet both business and technical requirements before release. Acting as a key partner to Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams, you will translate product requirements into effective test strategies and ensure that defects are identified early and resolved efficiently.

The role combines hands‑on testing, automation, and continuous improvement of quality practices, contributing to scalable and high‑quality systems used globally across markets and internal operations. You will also stay up to date with modern QA methodologies and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches.

What you'll do

You will ensure high‑quality delivery across Polestar’s digital platforms by validating solutions, improving test coverage, and driving continuous improvement in quality practices.

Your Responsibilities Include

Ensuring business requirements and acceptance criteria are fulfilled through comprehensive testing of user stories and system workflows
Designing, executing, and maintaining manual and automated tests across frontend, backend, APIs, and integrations
Validating quality, reliability, performance, and security of new platform capabilities and releases
Collaborating with Software Engineers, Technical Leads, Product Managers, and Designers to translate product requirements into effective test strategies
Identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects, while supporting teams in root‑cause analysis and resolution
Contributing to test automation frameworks and improving overall test coverage and development practices
Working closely with cross‑functional agile teams to continuously improve software quality and delivery processes
Monitoring and evaluating quality metrics and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
Staying up to date with industry best practices, modern QA methodologies, and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches
Documenting test plans, test results, and quality standards across the development lifecycle

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, Technical Leads, and Operations teams, ensuring alignment across technical and business needs while driving quality across the full development lifecycle.

Who you are

You are a structured and analytical quality professional with strong ownership and a proactive approach to ensuring high‑quality outcomes. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams, and you focus on identifying and resolving issues early to enable smooth and reliable delivery.

You combine hands‑on testing expertise with a continuous improvement mindset and an interest in modern technologies shaping the future of software quality.

To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

Strong knowledge and hands‑on experience with Quality Assurance methodologies and software testing principles
Experience testing modern web applications and distributed systems across frontend and backend technologies
Experience with test automation tools and frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing
Understanding of React, TypeScript, .NET (C#), Node.js, APIs, and AWS‑based systems from a testing perspective
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub workflows, and containerized environments
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and experience working in cross‑functional product teams
Strong analytical, organizational, problem‑solving, and communication skills
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and stakeholders
Experience with commerce, payments, financing, order management, or customer journey platforms is considered an advantage
Atleast 4 years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance

People at Polestar

We know that a change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate‑neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative.

Together, we are creating, collaborating, and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility. We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.

Is this you?

If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don’t wait to submit your application. We apply a continuous selection process and the job post will remain open until the position is filled.

As we move through the Swedish summer holiday season, there may be a slight delay in our process. We look forward to getting back to you in August.

Send us your resume along with a short note on what makes this role interesting to you. We read everything.

Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric, by the way…

jobs.title: Head of Application Development
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Vill du vara med och leda utvecklingen av mjukvara som gör skillnad för cancerpatienter världen över? 

På RaySearch kombinerar vi avancerad teknik med ett tydligt syfte: att förbättra cancervården genom innovativ mjukvara som används på cancerkliniker världen över. Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett starkt teknikintresse med ett meningsfullt uppdrag, där ditt ledarskap bidrar till att göra skillnad för människor varje dag.

Nu genomför vi en förändring inom vår utvecklingsorganisation och söker två erfarna ledare till våra nya sektioner Application Development 1 och Application Development 2. Rollerna är centrala i arbetet med att stärka och vidareutveckla vår applikationsutveckling. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för att bygga en stark, skalbar och högpresterande utvecklingsorganisation med fokus på förbättringsarbete, kompetensutveckling, samarbete och leverans. Som en del av vår nya linjeorganisation med fem sektioner inom utvecklingsavdelningen kommer ni att arbeta nära de övriga sektionerna som ansvarar för produktutvecklingens inriktning och genomförande, produkternas säkerhet och validering samt fysik och algoritmutveckling.

Om rollen

Som Head of Application Development ansvarar du för att utveckla organisationen bakom RaySearchs produkter vilka inkluderar RayStation, ett avancerat dosplaneringssystem för strålbehandling, och RayCare, ett innovativt onkologiskt informationssystem som stödjer hela cancerbehandlingsprocessen. Vi arbetar med en modern teknikstack som bland annat omfattar C#, .NET, SQL Server, WPF och React.

Du rapporterar till Director of Development och leder ett antal gruppchefer. Hur ansvar och direktrapporter fördelas mellan de två rollerna avgörs utifrån verksamhetens behov och de personer som tillträder tjänsterna. Ni arbetar nära varandra för att utveckla både era sektioner och avdelningen som helhet.

I rollen som Head of Application Development leder du arbetet med att sätta riktningen för applikationsutvecklingen och ser till att organisationen har förmågan att omsätta den i väl fungerande produkter. Det innebär bland annat att:

•  Utforma och kommunicera strategi för mjukvaruarkitektur, designprinciper och teknisk inriktning.

•  Skapa arbetssätt och styrning som bidrar till hög kvalitet och lösningar som är enkla att vidareutveckla och kan växa med behoven.

•  Driva förbättringsarbete kring utvecklingsprocesser, verktyg, utvecklarnas produktivitet och användningen av AI. 

•  Bygga långsiktig teknisk kompetens utifrån verksamhetens och produkternas behov.

•  Säkerställa rätt bemanning, kompetens och organisatoriska förutsättningar för framgångsrik produktutveckling.

•  Stärka samarbetet mellan team och funktioner så att gemensamma prioriteringar får genomslag.

•  Leda och utveckla chefer och tekniska ledare.

Din profil

Du är en erfaren ledare med bakgrund från avancerad mjukvaruutveckling. Genom din tekniska kompetens och förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur, utvecklingsprocesser och tekniska vägval kan du bidra till både strategiska beslut och operativ utveckling. Du kan förena långsiktig teknisk strategi med de praktiska förutsättningar som krävs för att team ska kunna leverera med hög kvalitet.

Vi söker dig som har en masterexamen (M.Sc.) eller likvärdig utbildning och som kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Du har gedigen erfarenhet av att driva processförbättringar och öka operativ effektivitet samt ett starkt fokus på resultat, kvalitet och genomförande. Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av att jobba med medicinskteknisk mjukvara eller inom en annan reglerad verksamhet.

Som ledare har du mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och kan på ett trovärdigt sätt bygga engagemang, skapa samsyn och förmedla både strategiska och tekniska budskap till olika målgrupper. Du driver förändring och får människor med olika kompetenser att lyckas tillsammans. Du trivs i en prestigelös miljö där framgång skapas genom samarbete, kunskapsdelning och gemensamt ansvarstagande.

Ansökan

Du är välkommen att söka tjänsten genom formuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail men har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Henrik Friberger, henrik.friberger@raysearchlabs.com

jobs.title: Backend & DevOps-konsult (direktuppdrag) - Kollarna.se
jobs.description:
På Doktor.se definierar vi om det svenska sjukvårdssystemet genom att göra det mer tillgängligt, smidigt och effektivt, utan att kompromissa med kvalitet eller säkerhet. Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker en erfaren Backend- och DevOps-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.

Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

Vad uppdraget innebär

Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
Rådgivning i design- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

Vem vi söker

Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.

Du kan drifta Azure-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.

Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

Varför uppdraget är intressant

Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

Uppdragsvillkor

Uppdragsform:
Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

Uppdragslängd:
Enligt överenskommelse.

Omfattning:
40 timmar per vecka.

Start:
Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

Arbetsplats:
Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

Ersättning:
Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

Övrigt:
Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

Var med och gör skillnad i vården!

Som en del av vår urvalsprocess genomför vi ID-kontroll och begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Vi söker konsulter som vill arbeta direkt med oss och ber därför vänligt men bestämt att konsultmäklare, konsultbolag och rekryteringsföretag avstår från att kontakta oss.

På Doktor.Se vill vi göra saker annorlunda. Vi vill utmana och förändra en hel bransch. Allt började med en idé om att det måste gå att skapa en vårdlösning som är bättre anpassad till vår tid och våra behov. Att det måste gå att få moderna digitala verktyg och traditionell fysisk vård att samverka med utgångspunkt i patientens behov. Och att göra det så att det inte bara blir tillgängligt för våra patienter utan också bidrar till att utveckla det sätt som vård erbjuds på idag. För oss alla. Det här är faktiskt vad vi gör idag. Men vi är långt ifrån klara och är ute på en spännande förändringsresa. Där kan du få vara med och bidra.

jobs.title: Power Platform Konsult
jobs.description:
Du sitter i ett projektmöte.

Kunden beskriver ett problem som egentligen inte har någon självklar lösning. Det är komplext, kanske lite rörigt och exakt den typen av utmaning du gillar.

Du börjar ställa frågor, koppla ihop saker, skissa på lösningar i huvudet och du vet att du inte behöver ha alla svar själv. Du har nämligen ett team bakom dig som tänker lika mycket som du och kompletterar dig i det du inte kan.

Det är så det är att jobba på Compago.

Vi bryr oss inte om din debiteringsgrad. Vi tänker inte börja mäta den heller.

Och vi tror inte på lönemodeller som stressar mer än de motiverar. Vi tror istället på balans, trygghet och att faktiskt ha ett hållbart arbetsliv (ja, på riktigt).

Det vi gillar? Kluriga projekt, samarbete och att lösa svåra problem tillsammans. Du är personen som vet att du inte kan allt, men som är rejält nyfiken på att lära dig mer och gärna delar med dig längs vägen.

Hos oss samarbetar vi i projektform åt stora bolag som gör skillnad. Du får grotta ner dig i Power Platform och andra Microsoft-tekniker, förstå kundens verksamhet och bygga smarta lösningar, som förmodligen inte gjorts tidigare och som faktiskt används.

Vi jobbar med allt från SharePoint, Teams och Power BI till Copilot, Azure och Business Central. Kan du inte allt redan? Perfekt, då har du ju massor att lära dig hos oss.

Vem är du?

Om du kommer från kundsidan eller konsult spelar ingen roll. Du trivs med att jobba i projektform, har praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft-utveckling och en god förståelse för verksamhet.
