Job Requisition ID #

26WD100450

Position Overview

Autodesk is looking for a Software Quality Assurance Engineer / Software Engineer in Test
to join the Autodesk Revit Cloud Worksharing team.

Autodesk Revit is world-leading Building Information Modeling (BIM) software used by architects, engineers, and building industry professionals to design everything from homes and businesses to airports, skyscrapers, and major landmarks.

In this role, you will help ensure that the software and cloud services our customers depend on are reliable, usable, and high quality. You will work as part of a collaborative, cross-functional Agile team alongside software developers, quality engineers, product managers, and other engineering partners.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer who is interested in both software quality assurance and test automation
. You will develop skills across exploratory and functional testing, automated testing, cloud technologies, troubleshooting, and software development practices while contributing directly to the quality of Autodesk Revit and Revit Cloud Worksharing.

You will report to a Software Engineering Manager and work with teammates distributed across multiple regions and time zones. The team collaborates globally, so your working hours should provide meaningful overlap with the US Eastern time zone.

Responsibilities

Participate in Agile/Scrum team activities and contribute to discussions about product quality, test strategy, and release readiness
Work with developers, QA engineers, and Software Engineers in Test to understand new features and identify appropriate testing approaches
Create clear, well-structured test plans and test cases based on product requirements and real-world customer workflows
Perform functional, exploratory, integration, regression, and system testing across desktop and cloud-based components
Identify, reproduce, document, and help troubleshoot software defects
Learn to use logs, debugging tools, telemetry, and other diagnostic information to help isolate problems and identify potential root causes
Develop and maintain automated tests with guidance from more experienced engineers
Contribute automated tests to Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines
Review automated and manually collected test results and help identify failures, trends, and areas of risk
Help evaluate where automation can improve test coverage, reliability, and engineering efficiency
Simulate real-world customer workflows and provide feedback to developers and product designers about usability and product quality
Collaborate with Product Support and engineering teams to understand customer-reported issues and improve the post-release customer experience
Learn Revit, Revit Cloud Worksharing, and related Autodesk workflows and technologies
Participate in team and cross-team quality initiatives and share knowledge with teammates
Continuously develop your skills in software testing, automation, cloud technologies, and quality engineering practices

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Up to 2 years of professional, internship, co-op, academic, or project experience related to software development, software testing, engineering, or a similar technical discipline
Basic understanding of software testing concepts such as test cases, test plans, defect reporting, and debugging
Experience with or coursework in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, C#, JavaScript, Java, or similar
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with an interest in investigating how software works and why it fails
Ability and willingness to learn new applications, technologies, and development processes
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to collaborate effectively within a diverse, globally distributed team
Curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering a high-quality customer experience

Preferred Qualifications

Internship, academic, or professional experience with software quality assurance or automated testing
Familiarity with one or more automated testing tools or frameworks
Exposure to Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment concepts or tools
Familiarity with cloud platforms or cloud-based applications such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience working in Windows and/or Linux environments
Familiarity with Agile or Scrum software development practices
Knowledge of the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry
Experience with Autodesk Revit or other Autodesk/AEC software
Experience designing buildings, working with BIM models, or using engineering or architecture software
Interest in learning both customer-focused quality assurance and software engineering approaches to automated testing
Basic experience using AI-assisted development tools to help write, understand, debug, or improve code and automated tests
Familiarity with using generative AI tools to assist with tasks such as creating test cases, generating test data, troubleshooting failures, or documenting technical work
An interest in learning how AI can be applied responsibly to improve software development, test automation, and quality engineering workflows

You do not need to meet every preferred qualification. We are looking for someone with a strong learning mindset who is excited to develop skills across software quality, test engineering, automation, and emerging AI-assisted development practices

What Will Help You Succeed

You will thrive in this role if:

You are curious and enjoy understanding how complex systems work
You approach problems from the customer’s point of view
You enjoy finding problems—and are equally interested in helping prevent them
You want to learn how automation can make software testing more reliable and efficient
You are comfortable asking questions, gathering feedback, and collaborating across disciplines
You use data and evidence to help make decisions
You see unexpected failures as opportunities to learn and improve
You take ownership of your work while seeking guidance when needed
You care about earning and maintaining our customers’ trust

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Romania based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 126,000 RON and 184,800 RON. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

jobs.title: Director, AI Data Architect
jobs.description:
Join Pfizer International Commercial Division, Business Transformation organization to leverage cutting-edge technology for critical business decisions and enhance customer experiences for colleagues, patients, and physicians. Our team of data engineering, data science, and AI professionals is at the forefront of Pfizer’s transformation into a digitally driven organization, using data science and AI to change patients’ lives, leading process and engineering innovations to advance AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.

As the AI Data Architect you will be the senior individual-contributor authority for AI-ready data across International Commercial. You will define what "AI ready" means in practice: designing the data models, semantic layers and readiness standards that allow analytical and agentic AI solutions to consume commercial data reliably, safely and at scale.

This role owns the architecture and modelling backbone of the AI data product portfolio: dimensional and semantic model design, AI readiness assessment frameworks, and data product blueprints, from source analysis through to certified, AI-consumable data assets.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. You will influence through architectural leadership: setting standards, reviewing designs, and enabling engineering pods and market teams to build AI-ready data products with speed, quality and consistency.

What You Will Achieve

AI Data Readiness
Own and evolve the AI readiness framework and criteria used to assess, certify and prioritise datasets for AI consumption across international markets
Conduct AI readiness assessments of commercial data sources and define remediation roadmaps (data quality, metadata, semantics, access) in partnership with market and platform teams
Extend AI readiness beyond structured data: define architectures and enrichment strategies (parsing, chunking, metadata, embeddings) that make unstructured content such as documents, transcripts and field notes AI-consumable
Define reusable standards, blueprints and accelerators that enable market teams to achieve AI readiness independently
Stay current with emerging AI data architecture patterns (semantic layers, agentic data access, retrieval) and evaluate their applicability to the International Commercial roadmap
Data Modelling & Semantic Layer Design
Design dimensional and analytical data models (fact and dimension design, grain definition, surrogate key and conformed dimension strategy) optimised for both human analytics and AI/agentic consumption
Architect and govern semantic layers, business ontologies and metric definitions that ensure consistent business meaning across markets, brands and data products
Model knowledge graphs and graph-based representations (entities, relationships, ontologies) where connected data improves discovery, retrieval and agent reasoning
Establish modelling standards for AI consumption: naming conventions, documentation, lineage, constraints and machine-readable metadata
Resolve complex cross-source integration and dimension-alignment challenges (master data, identifiers, encodings) spanning global and local market datasets
Solution & Architecture Design
Translate business and AI use-case requirements into target-state data architectures and data product designs
Design semantic search and retrieval architectures: embedding pipelines, vector storage and hybrid retrieval (keyword, vector and graph) that ground AI agents in governed enterprise data
Partner with Product Owners, data engineers and AI engineers to ensure designs are implementable, performant and production grade
Align designs with enterprise Data and AI Platform standards (governance, security, cataloguing) while maintaining product delivery velocity
Technical Leadership & Enablement
Act as the subject-matter expert and design authority for AI-ready data: lead design reviews, author architecture decision records (ADRs) and reference architectures
Coach and upskill data engineers and market teams on modelling and AI readiness best practices, without direct people management
Champion engineering and data quality excellence through documentation, patterns and continuous learning (labs, guilds, demos)

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, or related field
10+ years in data architecture, data engineering or analytics engineering, with a proven track record as a senior individual contributor
Deep expertise in data modelling: dimensional modelling (Kimball), normalized and analytical schema design, grain and surrogate key strategy
Strong hands-on experience designing AI-ready data products and semantic layers end-to-end
Experience architecting for unstructured data (documents, text, transcripts, images): extraction, chunking, enrichment and metadata strategies for AI consumption
Proficiency in SQL, Python with practical experience in Snowflake
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), modern data stack tooling (dbt, Airflow) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
Experience with AI ready data enablement frameworks and practical implementations, Semantics management and Enterprise data catalogues (Collibra)
Experience with complex data sources including anonymized patient data (EMR/Claims)
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal); ability to work across global time zones

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or Data Science
Experience enabling LLM and agentic data access patterns (semantic views, text-to-SQL agents, retrieval-augmented generation)
Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (e.g. Snowflake Cortex Search, pgvector, Pinecone, OpenSearch) including hybrid search, re-ranking and evaluation of retrieval quality
Experience with graph databases and knowledge graphs (e.g. Neo4j, Amazon Neptune; property graph or RDF/OWL modelling, GraphRAG patterns)
Experience with data governance and master data management in a global organisation
Experience with BI/visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Streamlit)
Experience in regulated/compliance-aware environments (GxP, HIPAA, SOC2)
Certifications: Snowflake, AWS/Azure Professional

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Verification tooling, infrastructure and automation framework architecture.

At Cochlear, you'll have the opportunity to work on technology that genuinely improves people's lives while continuing to grow your technical expertise.

Linux and Bash scripting.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer Container - Plattform & Automatisierung - Post Business Solutions GmbH
jobs.description:
Das sind wir

Erlebe das Beste aus zwei Welten: Unser Geschäftsfeld Post Business Solutions agiert als starker B2B Digital Services Provider im sicheren Konzernumfeld der Österreichischen Post AG. Als führende Anbieterin von B2B-Lösungen in den Bereichen Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und Outsourcing von Geschäftsprozessen gestalten wir moderne Informations- und Dokumentenprozesse für unsere Kund*innen.

Für diese Position wirst du Teil eines kleinen, pragmatischen Teams, das ein zentrales System betreibt, über das geschäftskritische Daten aus Produktionsabläufen gesammelt, verarbeitet und für Verrechnung, Versand sowie weitere Geschäftsprozesse bereitgestellt werden. Unsere Systemlandschaft ist über viele Jahre gewachsen und befindet sich aktuell in einer intensiven Modernisierungsphase. Dabei treiben wir die Containerisierung unserer Anwendungen, den Abbau technischer Schulden sowie die Automatisierung von Betriebsprozessen voran.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, moderne Plattformen mitzugestalten, nachhaltige technische Lösungen zu entwickeln und gemeinsam im Team Dinge voranzubringen, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Was bei dir ankommt

Finanzielle Vorteile & Zusatzleistungen: 400,- EUR Essensbons jährlich, gratis bank99‑Konto, jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg sowie bis zu 3.000,- EUR Ersparnis pro Jahr mit „goodie – die Post Bonuswelt“ (Rabatte für Reisen, Shopping, Sport & Gesundheit sowie Events & Kultur)
Urlaub & Erholung: Vergünstigte Urlaubsangebote in über 40 postsozial‑Ferienhäusern und Partnerhotels
Mitarbeiter*innenvorteile: Attraktive Handy‑ und Internettarife der Post‑Eigenmarke „Yelllow“, auch für Family & Friends
Gesundheit & Arbeitsumfeld: Ganzheitliche Gesundheitsförderung mit vielfältigen Maßnahmen sowie ein kollegiales und krisensicheres Arbeitsumfeld

Worauf es in diesem Job ankommt

Du entwickelst und betreibst gemeinsam mit dem Team eine stabile, sichere und skalierbare Container-Plattform.
Du automatisierst Infrastruktur- und Betriebsprozesse mithilfe von Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD-Pipelines und Skripting.
Du analysierst wiederkehrende Incidents und Betriebsprobleme und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen statt kurzfristiger Workarounds.
Du identifizierst Automatisierungs- und Optimierungspotenziale und reduzierst manuelle Tätigkeiten.
Du arbeitest an modernen Deployment- und Betriebsstrategien für bestehende und neue Anwendungen.
Du unterstützt die Modernisierung unserer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft und bringst dein Know-how im Bereich Plattform-Engineering ein.
Du dokumentierst Lösungen, teilst dein Wissen im Team und bringst neue Ideen ein.

Worauf es uns ankommt

Du bringst Erfahrung mit Containern und Container-Plattformen mit.
Du verfügst über gute Linux-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit automatisierten Deployment- und Betriebsprozessen.
Du hast bereits mit Infrastructure as Code gearbeitet oder möchtest dein Know-how in diesem Bereich gezielt ausbauen.
Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung in C#, Blazor und oder CI/CD-Plattformen
Du interessierst dich für Cloud-native-Technologien, moderne Plattformarchitekturen und komplexe Systemlandschaften.
Du analysierst gerne Ursachen, denkst lösungsorientiert und arbeitest erfolgreich im Team.
Kenntnisse in Azure sowie Tools wie Terraform, Ansible, Bicep sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss

Bezahlung je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation, jedoch mindestens 57.000,- Euro brutto jährlich (All-in, inklusive MbO-Zielvereinbarung).

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect Storefront (w/m/x)
jobs.description:
IBM IX – Experience The Human Factor.

Bist du bereit, die Zukunft des eCommerce mitzugestalten? Als Solution Architect – Storefront leitest du die Entwicklung moderner Storefront-Lösungen, die ganzheitliche Commerce-Erlebnisse ermöglichen. Du arbeitest eng mit dynamischen Teams zusammen, führst Kund*innen durch spannende Projekte und implementierst skalierbare, innovative Lösungen – unterstützt durch GenAI, um Performance und Produktivität weiter zu steigern. Bleibe am Puls der Zeit und forme die nächste Generation von eCommerce-Plattformen. Bereit, deinen Fußabdruck zu hinterlassen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams als Senior Solution Architect Storefront (w/m/x)!

Deine Aufgaben

Du steuerst die Konzeption und Implementierung durchgängiger Commerce-Erlebnisse, entwickelst moderne Storefront-Lösungen und führst detaillierte Assessments sowie Aufwandsschätzungen durch, um Geschäftsanforderungen mit skalierbaren, robusten Architekturen abzugleichen
Du arbeitest eng mit cross-funktionalen Teams (Sales, UX/UI, Engineering) zusammen, um umfassende Architekturkonzepte und Storefront-Lösungen zu entwickeln
Du nimmst an Discovery-Workshops, Projekt-Kick-offs, Kundenterminen und weiteren architekturrelevanten Aktivitäten teil und unterstützt mit technischer Expertise eine erfolgreiche Projektauslieferung
Du erstellst Präsentationen, Demos und Proof-of-Concepts, die den Mehrwert unserer Lösungen vermitteln und die technische Machbarkeit der Storefront-Designs demonstrieren
Du baust und pflegst vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Kund*innen und Stakeholdern, verfolgst ihre sich verändernden Anforderungen und identifizierst neue Potenziale für Zusammenarbeit und Solution‑Erweiterungen
Du berätst Kund*innen hinsichtlich effizienter, wertorientierter Prozesse zur Verwaltung einer composable Storefront (z. B. Page Building über PXM, CMS, Commerce und Suche)
Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung von Best Practices, Whitepapern, Case Studies und Thought‑Leadership-Inhalten mit, die unser Sales- und Consulting-Team unterstützen
Du hältst dein Wissen zu Trends, Technologien und Best Practices im Storefront‑ und eCommerce‑Umfeld stets aktuell und entwickelst deine Expertise kontinuierlich weiter

Deine Fähigkeiten

Du verfügst über solide Erfahrung in eCommerce‑Architekturen in B2B-, B2C- und Multi‑Party‑Umgebungen und hast nachweislich innovative, skalierbare Storefront-Lösungen erfolgreich umgesetzt
Du bringst fundierte technische Expertise in modernen Storefront‑Technologien wie Commercetools, Adobe Commerce oder Shopify mit und besitzt ein tiefes Verständnis für Headless Commerce und API‑basierte Integrationen
Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Netlify, Vercel und Hyperscalern, um performante und skalierbare Storefronts zu betreiben
Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Commerce‑Lösungen mit Node.js, Next.js, React und MACH‑Architekturen
Du nutzt GenAI‑Tools effektiv zur Produktivitätssteigerung und darauf ausgerichtet, wiederverwendbare Assets und Automatisierungen aufzubauen
Du verfügst über starke Problemlösungskompetenzen und verstehst, wie man Lösungen entwickelt, die technische und geschäftliche Anforderungen ausgewogen verbinden
Du arbeitest proaktiv und kollaborativ, übernimmst Ownership für deine Projekte und stellst hohe Qualitätsstandards sowie Detailgenauigkeit sicher
Du bist reisebereit und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (C1‑Level), um in einem dynamischen, zweisprachigen Umfeld effektiv zu arbeiten

Deine Perspektive

Professional Growth 

Wir bieten verschiedene Möglichkeiten zur individuellen Weiterentwicklung durch unsere interne Akademie und „Design yourself“-Programme, einschließlich Inhouse-Coaching und Mentoring. Außerdem hast du vollen Zugang zu allen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten von IBM. 

Work-Life Balance 

Unsere Kernarbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstage und Hybrid-Work-Modell helfen dir, dein Leben flexibler zu gestalten.   

Health & Well-Being 

Dein Wohlbefinden ist genauso wichtig, wie deine Gesundheit. Deshalb bieten wir unterschiedliche Maßnahmen im Bereich Mental Health an, die deine mentale und körperliche Gesundheit stärken.   

Team & Culture  

Unser Ziel ist es, dass sich jeder sicher, gebraucht und wertgeschätzt fühlt. Freue dich auf tolle Team- und Firmen-Events.   

Corporate Benefits & Incentives  

Profitiere von großartigen IBM-Rabatten und von internen Incentives, die deinen Einsatz würdigen, wie unser „Bring a friend“ Bonus-Programm.

Über uns

Mit 60 Studios weltweit zählt IBM iX zu den größten Anbietern für Digital Experience Services weltweit. Als Teil von IBM Consulting, der Beratungs- und Serviceeinheit von IBM, ist IBM iX Beratung, Digitalagentur, Design-Studio und Tech-Company in einem. An der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Design und Technologie begleiten die Teams Organisationen, Unternehmen und Marken bei der digitalen Transformation. Im deutschsprachigen Raum gestalten Expert*innen digitale Erlebnisse, die den Menschen in den Mittelpunkt stellen – basierend auf IBM Technologien und in Zusammenarbeit mit führenden Technologiepartnern wie Adobe, Salesforce und SAP CX.

Du fühlst dich in der Welt der digitalen Trends zu Hause und liebst es, Projekte mit echter Wirkung voranzutreiben? Dann werde Teil unseres IBM iX Teams!

IBM iX widmet sich der Schaffung eines inklusiven Arbeitsumfeldes, das Chancengleichheit für alle bietet. Wir möchten insbesondere alle Menschen mit ihren individuellen, diversen Hintergründen und Perspektiven darin bestärken, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

Wir bieten dir ein marktkonformes Gehalt über dem Mindestlohn. Aus rechtlichen Gründen weisen wir darauf hin, dass das kollektivvertragliche Mindestbruttojahresgehalt (KV) 64.554 EUR beträgt.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit aktuellem Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnissen und sehr gern auch einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben.

Hast du Fragen zur Stelle? Bitte kontaktiere deinen Talent Acquisition Partner:

Isabella Görke

jobs.title: Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform) (all genders welcome)
jobs.description:
Arbeiten bei COSMO CONSULT ist anders.

Entdecke unser Universum und lasse Dich von der positiven Energie der COSMOnaut*innen anstecken.

Gestalte die Zukunft von und mit Menschen und wachse mit uns gemeinsam.

Erlebe echte Wertschätzung in einem sicheren Umfeld voll Leidenschaft und Innovation - ganz unabhängig davon, wann und von wo aus Du arbeiten möchtest.

Werde Teil des Teams und gehöre zu einem der weltweit führenden Microsoft-Partnern für Unternehmenstransformation und Digitalisierung.

Lebe Deinen Job anders
- bewirb Dich bei uns als

Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform)

Das macht Dich anders.

Wir sind auf einer Wellenlänge, wenn Du:

smarte Entscheidungen triffst. Du musst nicht immer die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen, aber immer mit bestem Gewissen gegenüber unseren Kunden, Kolleg*innen und COSMO entscheiden.
den Menschen bei all Deinen Überlegungen in den Mittelpunkt stellst. Du achtest auf die Bedürfnisse aller Menschen und agierst mit Empathie und Mitgefühl.
Verantwortung übernimmst. Du bist achtsam gegenüber Dir und Deinen Mitmenschen. Auf Dich kann man sich auch über Deinen Aufgabenbereich hinaus verlassen.
uns dabei unterstützt, großartige Teams zu bilden. Alle für Dich und Du für alle - gemeinsam stärker sein. Du machst den Unterschied in Deinem Team.
immer Dein Bestes gibst. Du musst nicht der oder die Beste sein, aber aus tiefstem Respekt gegenüber Dir und Deinem Umfeld immer das Bestmögliche geben.
den Mut hast zu wachsen. Du denkst nicht in Herausforderungen, sondern in Möglichkeiten. Du liebst es, Dich weiter zu entwickeln, suchst nach neuen Ideen und bringst diese aktiv ein.
Dinge mit Leidenschaft tust. Du weißt, was Dich antreibt und begeistert, lebst Deine Leidenschaft, inspirierst dadurch Dein Umfeld, hast mehr Spaß an Deiner Arbeit und bist erfolgreicher.

Deine Persönlichkeit und Motivation ist das, was Dich ausmacht.

Daher nehmen wir uns die Zeit und schauen alle Bewerbungen individuell durch.

Du möchtest Geschäftsprozesse neu denken und Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, das Potenzial von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform erfolgreich zu nutzen?

Dein Alltag - nur ohne Alltag

Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform.
Dabei begleitest Du Projekte von der ersten Analyse über das Lösungsdesign bis zur Umsetzung und Einführung. Du verstehst die fachlichen Anforderungen unserer Kunden, übersetzt sie in tragfähige Lösungen und behältst dabei immer die End-to-End-Prozesse im Blick.

Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung übernimmst Du dabei unterschiedliche Aufgaben:

Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale.
Du führst Workshops mit Fachbereichen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten durch.
Du entwickelst strukturierte Lösungskonzepte und stimmst diese mit unseren Kunden ab.
Du setzt Lösungen selbst um oder koordinierst die Umsetzung im Team.
Du verantwortest Arbeitspakete und stellst Qualität, Standards und eine gute Dokumentation sicher.
Du bewertest Integrationen und Abhängigkeiten zu angrenzenden Systemen.
Du führst Schulungen durch und begleitest die Einführung, damit Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag nachhaltig genutzt werden.
Dabei arbeitest Du nicht nur innerhalb eines einzelnen Systems: Du denkst Prozesse, Daten und Anwendungen ganzheitlich und entwickelst Lösungen, die fachlich sinnvoll, technisch umsetzbar und langfristig skalierbar sind.

Hier bringst du Dich ein:

Du denkst Lösungen konsequent aus Nutzersicht und strukturierst sie in klare, skalierbare Use Cases.
Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungen innerhalb der Microsoft-Plattform und verbindest fachliche und technische Perspektiven.
Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und internen Teams zusammen und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zielführend zusammen.
Du entwickelst Dein Know-how kontinuierlich weiter, bleibst technologisch am Puls der Zeit und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv.
Du bringst neue Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen und gestaltest Veränderungen aktiv mit.

Dein Umfeld: Teams, Tools, Zusammenarbeit

Team & Setup

Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams mit Consultants, Entwickler*innen, Architekt*innen und weiteren Microsoft-Spezialist*innen.
Direkter Austausch mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung von Lösungen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten kombiniert mit engem Teamzusammenhalt, Wissensaustausch und fachlicher Zusammenarbeit.

Tools & Arbeitsweise

Arbeiten im Microsoft-Ökosystem rund um Dynamics 365 CRM (Sales, Customer Service und/oder Field Service), die Power Platform mit Power Apps, Power Automate und Dataverse sowie angrenzende Microsoft- und Azure-Lösungen.
Bewertung und Einsatz neuer Technologien, insbesondere zur Automatisierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie zur Nutzung von KI-Potenzialen.
Strukturierte und priorisierte Arbeitsweise, auch in parallelen Projekten und dynamischen Kundenumgebungen.
Kombination aus eigenständiger Umsetzung, fachlicher Beratung und gezielter Steuerung im Projektteam.

Deine Lernkurve bei COSMO CONSULT

Woche 1–4: Ankommen und verstehen

Du lernst unsere Projektmethoden, Kundenstrukturen und Lösungsansätze kennen.
Du bringst Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen aktiv in laufende Kundenprojekte ein und

übernimmst frühzeitig Verantwortung für erste Themen und Arbeitspakete.

Du verstehst, wie wir Anforderungen in konkrete Lösungen übersetzen und welchen Beitrag diese zum Geschäftserfolg unserer Kunden leisten.

Nach 3 Monaten: Übernehmen und umsetzen

Du verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete und setzt diese strukturiert und lösungsorientiert um.
Du arbeitest sicher mit Kunden und Projektteams zusammen und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsdesigns und Projektentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst Lösungen weiter und passt Dich flexibel an neue Anforderungen und Technologien an.

Nach 6 Monaten: Weiterentwickeln und mitgestalten

Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst bestehende Lösungsansätze innerhalb von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform weiter und berücksichtigst dabei fachliche, technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.
Du bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung von Lösungen, Methoden und Prozessen ein und unterstützt den Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams.

Das bringst Du mit:

Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Umsetzung von Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
Praxiserfahrung mit der Microsoft Power Platform, insbesondere Power Apps, Power Automate und/oder Dataverse
Kenntnisse in mindestens einem relevanten Dynamics-365-Modul, zum Beispiel Sales, Customer Service oder Field Service
Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse, Systemgrenzen, Integrationen und End-to-End-Zusammenhänge
Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen zu analysieren und in klare, umsetzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen
Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Workshops und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Projektteams
Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für fachliche Lösungen und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung zu übernehmen
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Aus gesetzlichen Gründen weisen wir darauf hin, dass das kollektivvertragliche, monatliche Mindestgehalt für diese Position € 3.954,- brutto (Vollzeit) beträgt. Unsere tatsächlichen Gehaltspakete orientieren sich an aktuellen Marktgehältern und berücksichtigen selbstverständlich Deine Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Du entscheidest wann und wo, damit es für Dich, Dein Team und Deinen Arbeitstag am besten passt.
Auf Deiner Reise bist Du nicht allein. Durch unser Level Up Programm gestalten wir Deine berufliche Zukunft gemeinsam.
Wir fragen nicht ob, sondern wie. Unsere Innovation Challenge und die Trainings in unserem COSMO College sind nur einige Beispiele dafür.
Es ist uns wichtig, dass es Dir gut geht. Das bringen wir durch verschiedene Wege und Benefits zum Ausdruck.
Wir kümmern uns um Mensch und Umwelt. Mit #thepowerofpeople schaffen wir einen sicheren Raum für eine positive, nachhaltige und internationale Zusammenarbeit.

Du möchtest Teil des Teams werden?

Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinen aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen und Deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum direkt online.

Du möchtest mehr #insideCOSMO?

to join our Playgami team in Barcelona

Playgami is Scopely's internal technology platform that powers some of the world's most successful live games. Our products help game teams operate and scale their games, serve millions of daily players, and process the vast amount of data generated across the Scopely ecosystem.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of engineers building the platforms, services, and tools that enable game teams to deliver exceptional player experiences. You will play a key role in shaping both the technical direction of our products and the growth of the engineers on your team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Seqera

Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity’s biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence.

We’re a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we’re strengthening our internal foundations - and that’s where you come in.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Unified Compute team and take ownership of the application layer that turns computational capability into something our customers can configure, run, and pay for - spanning Seqera Intelligent Compute, its integration with the Seqera Platform, and the metering and billing that sits behind them. This layer is essential to our customer-facing platform's operational success: it determines whether biotech innovators and researchers can set up the compute they need, run their workloads reliably wherever they run them, and see transparent, accurate insight into what they used and what it cost.

You will help shape a backend that supports compute environment provisioning across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, HPC schedulers and GPU executions; multi-tenant usage tracking and accurate billing computation across cloud and on-prem deployments; and the pay-as-you-go and free-tier onboarding journeys that bring new users onto the platform. The role spans high-impact engineering work - from system architecture design to data modeling, cloud provider integrations, and API development - using JVM technologies (Java, Groovy, Micronaut).

You will be empowered to influence our architecture decisions, improve the lifecycle of compute provisioning and billing processes, and collaborate closely with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to deliver world-class engineering outcomes. It is a broad scope, and you will own it end to end, with three engineers alongside you in the team to lean on for the hardest calls.

What You'll Do

Build and own the integration between Seqera Intelligent Compute and the Seqera Platform.
Own Platform compute environments: let customers set up and run compute across AWS, Azure and GCP, Kubernetes, HPC schedulers, and GPU-enabled executions - and handle the ways those backends differ.
Build against cloud provider APIs and SDKs, and handle what the real world returns: partial failures, quota and permission errors, provider quirks that leak into the product.
Own the billing and pay-as-you-go path - metering usage accurately, keeping usage events and invoices reconcilable, and making the free-user onboarding journey work.
Design data models and APIs that stay consistent across services and releases.
Make failures legible: turn raw provider and scheduler errors into something a user can act on, and add the tests and observability that make the next incident faster to diagnose.
Work directly with the Platform and product teams, and with support on escalations from real customers.
Take design decisions within your scope and document the system so it is not dependent on any one person.

About You

4+ years building and operating production backend services, with real ownership of at least one.
Strong in Java and/or Groovy, with Micronaut, Spring Boot or similar.
Real hands-on experience with a major cloud provider's API - provisioning and managing resources programmatically, not just deploying to it.
Have worked with Kubernetes as somewhere workloads actually run.
You care about correctness. Ideally you have worked on billing, metering or other systems where wrong data has consequences - and if not, you bring the same rigour to data integrity anyway.
Comfortable designing REST APIs and data models, and keeping integrations working across versions and failures.
Have been accountable for something customer-facing in production.
Comfortable inheriting a system, asking questions, and writing down what was never documented.
Comfortable with ambiguity - you develop hypotheses with limited information, drive work independently, and reach out early to stay unblocked.
We use AI every day and expect engineers to use it extensively. You do not need to be an expert, but you must be genuinely open to it.

Nice to have:

Multiple clouds - hands-on across two or more of AWS, Azure, GCP.
HPC and batch schedulers (Slurm, LSF, PBS, AWS Batch, Google Batch, Azure Batch).
GPU workloads and GPU-enabled provisioning.
Usage-based billing or monetization platforms (Metronome, Stripe) and pay-as-you-go pricing.
Self-serve or free-tier product work: signup funnels, usage limits, conversion.
Bioinformatics, Nextflow, or scientific computing background.
Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and CI/CD ownership.
Some frontend exposure (Angular).
Open-source contributions

Great benefits

jobs.title: Solution Architect (Databricks)
jobs.description:
The Digital Evolution Company Of Today And Tomorrow

Lutech Sweeft
es un referente tecnológico y un motor estratégico de innovación en Digital, Datos e IA dentro del mercado ibérico. Como parte del Grupo Lutech, combinamos nuestro reconocimiento como Google Cloud Partner of the Year 2024 con más de 30 años de experiencia como SAP Gold Partner . Diseñamos soluciones integrales que transforman organizaciones complejas en empresas inteligentes y orientadas al dato, desde la creación de infraestructuras preparadas para la IA hasta la optimización de sistemas críticos.

Únete a nosotros para impulsar el camino hacia la inteligencia accionable y generar un impacto global medible.

Puesto

Buscamos un perfil S enior Data Architect (DataBricks)
con las siguientes responsabilidades:

Responsabilidades

Apoyo en las fases de preventa proporcionando la información necesaria para definir una solución arquitectónica y su estimación de costes asociada.
Definición de la arquitectura de la solución —desde el diseño conceptual hasta las decisiones de implementación— documentando los fundamentos y las alternativas descartadas.
Gestión de restricciones contrapuestas —como rendimiento, costes operativos, seguridad, mantenimiento y plazos de entrega— y comunica claramente al cliente las compensaciones resultantes.
Garantía de la coherencia arquitectónica a lo largo del proyecto, verificando que las implementaciones se ajusten al diseño e interviniendo si la solución comienza a desviarse.
Coordina las operaciones del equipo técnico: asignación de tareas, verificación de resultados, realización de revisiones técnicas y gestión de escalados.
Gestión de la comunicación arquitectónica con los interlocutores técnicos y de negocio del cliente: recopilación de requisitos, explicación de decisiones de diseño, resolución de objeciones y acuerdo sobre prioridades de implementación.
Diseño de arquitecturas basadas en agentes: definiendo la división entre agentes y herramientas, el acceso a bases de conocimiento, las pasarelas de modelos, los puntos de control con intervención humana (*human-in-the-loop*) y los marcos de gobernanza.
Fomentar el crecimiento técnico del equipo evaluando nuevas tecnologías e integrando en las capacidades de la organización los hallazgos validados en la práctica.

Requisitos

Habilidades técnicas

Arquitectura de datos: capacidad para diseñar una plataforma de datos integral que abarque la ingesta desde fuentes heterogéneas, la organización en capas de refinamiento, el procesamiento por lotes y en tiempo real, y la exposición de datos a diversos consumidores.
Modelado: dominio de modelos analíticos y estrategias de historial de datos, con capacidad para seleccionar el enfoque adecuado según el caso de uso específico en lugar de basarse en la costumbre.
Procesamiento a gran escala: profundo conocimiento de los mecanismos de computación distribuida, sus limitaciones y los factores que determinan el costo y el rendimiento.
Big Data y Apache Spark en Databricks: dominio del ecosistema Spark y capacidad para dimensionar y optimizar cargas de trabajo distribuidas que implican grandes volúmenes de datos; esto incluye estrategias de particionamiento, minimización del intercambio de datos entre nodos (*shuffling*), selección de formatos de almacenamiento y tablas transaccionales, y gestión de costos de computación. Se requiere experiencia práctica en la ejecución y optimización de estas cargas de trabajo en el entorno de ejecución (*runtime*) de Databricks.
Plataforma Databricks (habilidad preferente y diferenciadora): conocimiento profundo de la arquitectura *lakehouse* y sus componentes, incluyendo el formato de tabla transaccional Delta Lake y las mejores prácticas de optimización, la organización de capas de refinamiento, las canalizaciones (*pipelines*) declarativas y la orquestación de flujos de trabajo, el motor SQL para análisis y la gestión de entornos de computación y políticas de acceso. Los candidatos deben ser capaces de justificar las decisiones de configuración y anticipar su impacto en el rendimiento y el costo.
Integración de Databricks en el ecosistema de nube: capacidad para ubicar la plataforma dentro de la arquitectura del cliente en Azure o AWS, abarcando el diseño del espacio de trabajo, redes y aislamiento, perfiles de identidad y acceso, almacenamiento subyacente e integración con servicios existentes de ingesta, orquestación y exposición de datos.
Arquitectura de sistemas generativos: capacidad para diseñar el marco de trabajo de una solución basada en modelos —incluyendo la orquestación de agentes, bases de conocimiento vectoriales y de grafos, pasarelas hacia proveedores de modelos, observabilidad y gobernanza de acceso— aprovechando los servicios nativos de Databricks para búsqueda vectorial, despliegue de modelos y evaluación de aplicaciones generativas.
Gobernanza de datos: catalogación, linaje de datos, calidad, gestión de acceso y cumplimiento de normativas de protección de datos. Se requiere competencia en el uso del catálogo unificado de Databricks como herramienta de gobernanza, abarcando la jerarquía de objetos, la definición de permisos granulares, el linaje y el intercambio de datos externos.
Integración: conocimiento de patrones de integración de aplicaciones —interfaces síncronas y asíncronas, mensajería, eventos— suficiente para diseñar la solución integral y colaborar eficazmente con los arquitectos de aplicaciones.
Industrialización: gestión de infraestructura como código, automatización de despliegues, segregación de entornos y observabilidad de la plataforma; específicamente en Databricks, esto implica el control de versiones del código, el empaquetado y promoción de activos entre entornos, y la automatización de los flujos de despliegue (*pipelines*).
Aspectos económicos de la solución: capacidad para estimar y controlar los costes operativos de una plataforma de datos y, en el caso de sistemas generativos, el coste por ejecución; a este nivel, constituye una responsabilidad arquitectónica fundamental.
Amplitud tecnológica: aunque Databricks sea la plataforma principal, se requiere experiencia con al menos otro ecosistema en la nube o plataforma de datos de terceros, así como la capacidad de identificar equivalentes funcionales, evaluar los riesgos de dependencia de un proveedor (*vendor lock-in*) y articular el posicionamiento de Databricks frente a las alternativas.
Seguridad: clasificación de la información, cifrado, segregación de accesos y auditoría, incluyendo el conocimiento de los requisitos propios de sectores regulados.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

jobs.title: Intern, Frontend QA Engineering
jobs.description:
Who we are 
We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your Mission

We're looking for a Frontend QA Engineering Intern to support our mission of delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing automated solutions. In this role, you’ll work alongside experienced QA engineers and developers to test new features, identify issues, and ensure the best possible user experience from the UI level.

Your focus will be on frontend testing across key example projects, such as operational workflows, AI integrations, and low-code automation tools. Leveraging modern low-code platforms like Appian and UiPath, your curiosity, attention to detail, and understanding of software quality principles will be key in maintaining Bitpanda’s standards of excellence, innovation, and operational scalability.

What You’ll Do

Execute Frontend Testing:

Support QA in ensuring product quality, reliability, and performance through structured frontend testing, validating end-to-end user journeys, AI integrations, and automated business processes.
Collaborate Across Teams:

Work closely with developers, Business Analysts, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements, document test cases, identify potential quality risks early in the development cycle and support UAT cycles.
Test Low-Code Test Automation:

Design, execute, and maintain frontend test cases using low-code automation tools such as Appian and UiPath, ensuring complete alignment with product and business objectives.
Monitor & Track Bugs:

Assist in monitoring, reporting, and tracking defects using standard QA tools and workflows (Jira), contributing clear visual proofs and step-by-step reproduction details for efficient issue resolution.
Drive Quality in Agile Sprints:

Participate actively in sprint planning and review meetings, sharing insights to enhance frontend test coverage and drive a culture of quality across teams.

Who You Are
Frontend & Quality Mindset:

Detail-oriented and proactive, with a keen interest in user experience, UI workflows, and ensuring the overall reliability of software products.
Low-Code & Automation Curious:

Familiar with core testing concepts (manual testing, test automation, agile methodologies) and eager to gain hands-on experience with low-code platforms like Appian and UiPath.
Methodical Problem-Solver:

Possess a strong analytical mindset to test beyond happy paths, naturally exploring boundary limits, non-numeric edge cases, and unexpected UI behaviors.
Structured Communicator:

Excellent collaborator able to document findings clearly, articulate technical issues with concrete real-world examples, and contribute to continuous team improvement.
Relevant Academic Background:

Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (preferred but not required).

What’s in it for you
Flexibility to work where you thrive

– Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
Reward for your impact

– Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
Support for your mental wellbeing

– Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
Time to recharge

– On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
Continuous learning and growth

– Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
Exclusive perks and rewards

– Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
Support during life milestones

– Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
Fuel and focus on-site

– Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
Recognition for your contributions

– Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
Show your Bitpanda pride

– Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
Connect and celebrate with your team

– Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.
Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. * These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
Valsea - Where Innovation Meets Entertainment

At Valsea, we’re shaping the future of entertainment with immersive, engaging experiences that captivate players worldwide. Based in sunny Marbella, Spain, our vibrant open-space office is home to an international team of developers, marketers, product owners, and much more.

Valsea operates a leading scalable technology platform, 100% owned by us. This gives us the freedom to deliver results fast. We integrate selected outside companies into our ecosystem to ensure we provide fresh and vibrant products for our customers.

We work in a fast-paced environment, creating new brands, maintaining and improving our tech stack, launching leading acquisition and retention campaigns, and developing fresh features. Our ethos is simple - be best-in-class in everything we do.

Despite our rapid growth, Valsea still has that exciting start-up feel. We embrace a hybrid working model to balance professional growth with personal well-being. With a dynamic work environment, attractive salary, and a culture that thrives on collaboration, our power is our people.

We provide company laptops and other things you may need to work comfortably. Remote workers are always invited to our annual company trip and other team events. Ready to be part of something exciting?

What are we looking for now?

A Staff-level engineer who has done this before: someone who can walk into a mature, high-scale platform, understand where AI genuinely moves the needle versus where it's just noise, and lead the engineering work to get it done. You're comfortable being the most senior technical voice in the room, but you'd rather be pairing with an engineer on a gnarly integration than sitting in a strategy deck all day. You think in systems, not scripts: production reliability, data quality, and security aren't afterthoughts to you, they're the job.

This isn't a research role. It's a build role, with the freedom and seniority to also set direction.

What You'll Do

Own the technical strategy and roadmap for AI adoption across Valsea's product, platform, and internal tooling, grounded in what's actually feasible on our stack, not slideware.
Architect and lead the delivery of AI-powered capabilities into our Scala/Go/Kafka backend, from recommendation and personalisation to support/fraud/risk signals, agentic automation, and internal developer tooling.
Set the vision and roadmap for agentic QA automation (using AI agents to expand test coverage, catch regressions earlier, and reduce manual QA load) and for AI-accelerated support and incident response that cuts time-to-detect and time-to-resolve.
Introduce AI tooling at the root of our SDLC pipelines (GitHub/GitLab: code review, testing, deployment gates), so AI assistance is built into how the team ships, not bolted on afterward.
Evaluate and integrate LLM and ML infrastructure (self-hosted and API-based), making pragmatic build-vs-buy calls that respect our scale, latency, and cost constraints.
Set Product Development standards for how AI features get designed, tested, monitored, and rolled back. Model-driven systems should meet the same rigour as any other production service.
Partner directly with Engineering leadership, Product, and Data to identify where AI creates real player or business value, and turn that into a delivery plan.
Act as a technical multiplier: mentor senior and mid-level engineers and managers, run design reviews, and raise the technical bar for how the wider team thinks about AI-assisted and AI-driven systems.
Stay hands-on: prototype fast, get into the codebase, and unblock hard integration and performance problems yourself when it matters.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in the JVM/Scala ecosystem (or a comparably strong background in a statically-typed, distributed-systems-heavy language) plus proven Staff/Principal-level scope: setting technical direction, not just executing it.
Hands-on experience shipping AI/ML-powered features into production at real scale, with real users: LLM integration, recommendation systems, applied ML, or agentic infrastructure.
Deep comfort with event-driven, distributed architectures (Akka/Pekko, Kafka or equivalent); you understand the failure modes, not just the happy path.
Strong, hands-on experience with distributed systems and container orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, and the operational patterns that come with running them at scale.
A track record of making sound build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including around cost, latency, data privacy, and vendor risk for AI systems specifically.
Product-minded: you think in terms of player impact and business outcomes, not just technical elegance.
A strong communicator who can move fluidly between a whiteboard architecture discussion with engineers and a plain-language case for leadership.
You thrive in ambiguity: this role starts with a mandate, not a spec, and you'll help write the spec.
Proficiency in professional-level English communication, written and verbal.

Nice To Have

Please note, these aren't requirements, just things we think would be particularly valuable. If anything or everything here doesn't apply to you, please don't let that put you off applying.

Good domain knowledge of entertainment or another regulated, high-throughput consumer platform is recommended.
Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
Background running or scaling self-hosted AI/LLM infrastructure and observability.
Exposure to fraud detection, risk scoring, or trust & safety systems.
Experience introducing AI tooling into an engineering organization's own workflows (dev tooling, code review, incident response), not just into the product.
Modern MLOps/LLMOps practices and tooling.

What We Offer

Hybrid working model from our office in Marbella (3 days/week) or fully remote (EU)
Innovative international company that uses cutting-edge tech equipment
Collaborative teams and agile multicultural environment
Competitive salary with flexible working hours
23 paid vacation days + public holidays
Private health insurance for you and your family
Free Online English/Spanish lessons
Corporate events throughout the year
Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

In-office Perks Such As

Daily breakfast and freshly cooked lunch 3 days a week
50% discount on personal training sessions and physiotherapy sessions
Games room, full kitchen with hot drinks, fruit, soft drinks
Gym, massage room and much more

At Valsea, we want diversity and inclusion in an environment where unique perspectives and new talents thrive. Join us in creating a workplace where everyone can shine and contribute to our collective success. Protecting your privacy and data security is a longstanding top priority for Valsea. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://valsea.teamtailor.com/data-privacy) to learn more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

We’re a diverse team with great people from across the world. This position is available both as a hybrid position in Marbella (Spain) or as a fully remote position from inside the EU. Please note that we are unable to sponsor work visas outside the EU.

We're a fast-growing engineering team on a mission to build the best ERP for Small Businesses in Europe. We work in a domain-based structure, where each domain has real ownership over its area — from architecture to quality and technical roadmap.

Your Role as a Domain Engineer

As a Domain Engineer, you're the technical reference for the product: you define architecture direction, ensure engineering standards, and work closely with team managers and Senior Engineers to make sure technical decisions serve the business goals. This is a senior IC role, focused on cross-cutting technical impact, not people management.

We're modernizing our stack and expanding into new markets, which means real problems around scale, multi-tenancy, and domain complexity — not greenfield, but not paralyzing legacy either.

What You'll Do

Own the target architecture of your domain and the realistic path to get there.
Ensure reliability, scalability, security, and compliance are design constraints from day one, not afterthoughts.
Maintain living architecture documentation (C4 model diagrams, ADRs) as part of the engineering workflow.
Set and calibrate design review thresholds, delegating to senior engineers as their judgment grows.
Spend roughly half your time embedded with engineering teams, and half on cross-engineering work — standards, the Golden Path, and the Architecture Forum.
Grow the architectural judgment of senior engineers, so fewer decisions need to come through you over time.
Partner with Engineering Directors, Engineering Managers, and Product to surface technical constraints and trade-offs with clarity.

📍 Job located in Porto with possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You

Scalable systems experience: You have significant hands-on experience designing and evolving systems at scale, ideally within multi-tenant SaaS or platform environments.

Tech stack & domain experience: You are comfortable with .NET, Angular, SQL Server, Azure, and modern CI/CD practices. Experience with financial, accounting, or ERP systems—as well as European regulatory compliance—is a strong differentiator.

The Principal Engineer is the foremost technical authority for AI-driven software delivery practices. The role defines engineering strategy, architecture standards, AI governance implementation, and enterprise-scale adoption of AI throughout the software development lifecycle. This individual drives transformation towards AI-native engineering practices while ensuring security, quality, traceability, and compliance. Inspired by emerging AI-DLC practices, the Principal Engineer guides teams in leveraging AI across requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations

Our client is a large global enterprise with a complex technology landscape and a strong focus on digital transformation and innovation. The organisation is investing in modern cloud, data, and AI capabilities
to build scalable, secure, and automated solutions across its business.

The project focuses on building an enterprise-grade AI Agent Platform from the ground up
, providing a standardised foundation for developing, deploying, orchestrating, securing, and observing AI agents. The initiative brings together AI orchestration, observability, security, governance, integrations, evaluation, and platform engineering
, giving engineers the opportunity to shape key architectural decisions and build a new platform from the ground up.

Responsibilities

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of software engineering experience.
5+ years leading architecture or platform engineering initiatives.
Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of modern AI/ML technologies, LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG, vector databases, and MLOps.
Strong experience in enterprise architecture and AI engineering platforms
, including LLM orchestration, RAG, and knowledge systems
.
Solid expertise in cloud-native architectures, microservices, event-driven systems, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevSecOps
across Azure, AWS, or GCP
.
Experience defining and implementing AI governance frameworks
and enterprise technology standards.
Strong strategic technical leadership
, systems thinking, and an innovation-driven approach.
Excellent executive communication
and ability to influence technology decisions across the enterprise.
Proven experience in mentoring and coaching
technical teams and driving architectural alignment.

Responsibilities

Define enterprise architecture and engineering standards for AI-enabled development.
Create frameworks, reference architectures, and reusable platform capabilities.
Act as the ultimate escalation point for complex technical decisions.
Lead adoption of AI-assisted software engineering practices.
Establish standards for prompt engineering, agent-based development, AI testing, AI observability, and AI governance.
Drive AI integration throughout the software development lifecycle.
Champion Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD), and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
Define best practices for automated code generation, review, validation, and deployment.
Establish engineering metrics and quality gates.
Ensure responsible AI implementation.
Define controls around security, privacy, bias, explainability, and compliance.
Collaborate with architecture, security, legal, and governance teams.
Mentor senior engineers and technical leads.
Drive engineering capability development and innovation.
Represent the organization in executive technical discussions.

Proven ability to track and supervise the resolution of several ongoing issues (using Kanban/Scrum) with good organization skills and ability to provide status feedback
Good communication skills and ability to obtain results from other teams
Autonomous and problem solver
Good level English.

Na Decskill, acreditamos que a excelência tecnológica nasce do talento humano.
Somos uma empresa de consultoria em IT com mais de 10 anos de experiência consolidada no mercado, focada na construção de relações de longo prazo, tanto com os nossos clientes como com as nossas pessoas. Hoje, somos uma comunidade com mais de 800 profissionais, a trabalhar a partir de Lisboa, Porto e Madrid, contribuindo para iniciativas tecnológicas com impacto.
Como parte do Grupo Astek, combinamos uma forte cultura local com uma presença global, estando presentes em cerca de 23 países, distribuídos por 4 continentes. Isto permite-nos oferecer um contexto internacional, desafios diversificados e oportunidades de carreira a longo prazo, mantendo sempre a proximidade com as nossas equipas.
Gostaríamos de conhecer um Senior Data Architect para um projeto com um modelo de trabalho híbrido em Lisboa
Com presença no escritório de 3 dias por semana.

Principais responsabilidades:

Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da organização, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia e objetivos de negócio.
Desenhar arquiteturas e soluções modernas de dados, considerando diferentes plataformas, tecnologias e necessidades de negócio.
Definir standards, patterns, princípios, guidelines e boas práticas de Data Architecture, Data Governance e Data Quality.
Definir, documentar e evoluir o Framework de Data Governance e Data Quality.
Definir arquiteturas e abordagens para Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Platforms e soluções de armazenamento NoSQL.
Avaliar e definir soluções em ambientes Cloud, nomeadamente Azure, AWS e/ou Google Cloud Platform.
Trabalhar com Microsoft Fabric e Databricks, incluindo arquitetura, integração, processamento, gestão e governação de dados.
Definir modelos e soluções para Data Catalog, Business Glossary, Data Lineage, Data Ownership e Data Stewardship.
Definir e evoluir a abordagem de Data Quality, incluindo metodologias, regras, métricas, KPIs e mecanismos de monitorização.
Garantir que os princípios de Data Governance e Data Quality são incorporados na arquitetura e no desenho das soluções.
Analisar requisitos e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de arquitetura de dados robustas, escaláveis e sustentáveis.
Avaliar diferentes tecnologias e abordagens, contribuindo para decisões de arquitetura e definição de roadmaps tecnológicos.
Apoiar e orientar equipas de engenharia e desenvolvimento na implementação das arquiteturas definidas.
Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas e projetos estratégicos relacionados com Data Architecture, Data Governance e Data Quality.
Promover o alinhamento entre equipas técnicas, arquitetura, negócio, Data Owners e Data Stewards.
Definir e acompanhar KPIs e mecanismos de reporting relacionados com a maturidade e adoção de Data Governance e Data Quality.
Produzir e manter documentação técnica e arquitetural.
Promover a melhoria contínua da arquitetura, plataformas e práticas de dados.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Informação ou área similar.
Experiência sólida como Data Architect, idealmente em ambientes de grande dimensão e elevada complexidade.
Conhecimentos avançados de Data Architecture, Data Governance e Data Quality.
Experiência comprovada em Data Ownership, Data Stewardship, Business Glossary, Data Catalog e Data Lineage.
Experiência na definição de standards, patterns, guidelines e princípios de arquitetura de dados.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Financial Calculations Engine (.NET)
jobs.description:
Dynamo Software is a leading global FinTech Research and Portfolio Management SaaS provider offering an industry-tailored, highly configurable SaaS platform solving challenges across the alternative investment landscape. For more than 25 years, the Dynamo™ platform has improved the productivity of fundraising, deal, research, investor servicing, portfolio management, and compliance teams worldwide. Collectively, Dynamo’s 1,000+ clients manage over $10 trillion in assets. Backed by the largest Private Equity firms in the world – Blackstone Growth
and Francisco Partners
, Dynamo is seeking to grow our team based on rapidly increasing demand for our financial technology solutions.

We are hiring a Software Engineer for one of our key FinTech product teams. In this role, you will help build business-critical solutions for alternative investment managers across the full investment lifecycle. It is a great fit for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, quickly understands business concepts, and is motivated to use modern AI-assisted development practices to deliver high-quality software.

Your daily life:

Building features in the calculation engine and core accounting logic: the code that turns fund transactions into positions, ownership, gains and losses, general-ledger entries, and performance figures such as IRR and returns.
Turning business requirements into precise, well-tested logic, working with product owners, project managers, and accounting experts on what a number should be, as well as on estimates and priorities.
Proving the numbers are right: automated tests that pin down calculation results and the edge cases that break them, such as currency conversion, rounding, missing values, and back-dated transactions.
Keeping calculations fast and memory-efficient on large client datasets, with an eye on SQL Server performance.
Triaging and fixing complex production issues, often a client reporting a figure that doesn't look right, and tracing it through the data and the logic to the root cause.
Working day to day with AI coding agents such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, which write a large share of the code. You validate, refine, and test what they produce.
Building AI agents and agent-based workflows that improve the product and how we work.
Taking part in the high-level design of the most complex features.

Our stack: C# and .NET, Microsoft SQL Server, and MSTest, with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as everyday tools.

What you bring
:

Experience: 4+ years designing and building software in C# and .NET.
SQL: Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills: complex queries, set-based logic, and finding out why a query is slow.
AI-assisted development: Regular, hands-on use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar) on real tasks, and the judgment to review, test, and correct what they produce.
Business logic: Experience turning business requirements into working software, ideally in a numbers-heavy domain such as finance, accounting, billing, or insurance. You pick up a new business domain quickly.
Testing: Automated testing is part of how you work. You write unit and integration tests and have a clear idea of what needs covering.
Design: Solid object-oriented design and design patterns, and an understanding of concurrency.
Problem solving: Strong analytical skills and the patience to follow a hard production problem through to the root cause.
Ownership: Proactive and able to work independently, with a drive to keep improving how things are done.
Communication: Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to talk through a requirement with a non-technical colleague.
Domain knowledge (a plus): Partnership accounting for alternative investment funds, fund or general-ledger accounting, or financial maths such as IRR and time-weighted returns.

What we offer:

The ability to have an impact. Good ideas come from everyone in our organization, and we are agile enough to embrace new ideas and directions.
The opportunity to gain knowledge and experience in the rapidly growing financial services and alternative assets industry.
A very attractive work culture in an established technology company where we take pride in our work and our people.
A flexible work environment with opportunities for hybrid work or flexible hours.
Professional development opportunities, including learning and development initiatives covered by the company.
Extended health insurance program for you and your family.
Flexible benefits program with plenty of options to choose from.
Events and team-building activities.
